# no-trailing-spaces

- ID: `MD009`
- Category: Whitespace and layout
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: yes
- Tags: `whitespace`

Outside code blocks, lines end in no spaces or tabs, or in exactly 2 of them.

## Why

Trailing whitespace in text does not change the output, except where 2 or more
spaces make a hard line break. In code blocks it is part of the code.

## Options

Set them under `rules.no-trailing-spaces.options`.

- `br_spaces` (`integer`, default `2`): Trailing spaces allowed for a hard line
  break. Values below 2 allow none.
- `list_item_empty_lines` (`boolean`, default `false`): Allow trailing spaces on
  empty lines inside list items.
- `strict` (`boolean`, default `false`): Also report br\_spaces where they make
  no line break, such as at the end of a paragraph.
- `ignore_code_blocks` (`boolean`, default `true`): Skip the lines of code
  blocks. Also accepted as `code_blocks`, with the opposite value.

## Fix

The fix deletes the trailing whitespace, or trims a hard line break to exactly 2
spaces. gomdlint reports some trailing whitespace without a fix, such as
whitespace inside a code span, which is code, or a tab where the paragraph goes
on to the next line, which some renderers read as a hard line break. gomdlint
may report a finding without a fix when the fix would change a line with one
character in brackets, such as \[x\] or \[1\], or the lines around it up to a
blank line, because it could add or remove a task list checkbox. In a document
with raw HTML other than comments and plain br, wbr, hr or img tags, gomdlint
reports every finding without a fix.

## Example

This document breaks the rule:

```markdown
# Guide

Install the tool. 
Then run it in the project root.
```

gomdlint reports:

```text
3:18 Trailing whitespace
```

The fix changes it to:

```markdown
# Guide

Install the tool.
Then run it in the project root.
```

## Configure

```yaml
rules:
  no-trailing-spaces:
    options:
      br_spaces: 2
```

Under `rules`, `no-trailing-spaces: false` turns the rule off and
`no-trailing-spaces: error` reports its findings as errors. The flag
`--disable no-trailing-spaces` turns it off for one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line no-trailing-spaces -->
```
